cands.bio: Ivan "Van" Smith is a Republican who has represented District 42 in the Alabama House of Representatives since November 6, 2019. He first won a 2019 special election. He was re-elected in 2022 and was unopposed in 2026.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Smith was born or raised, when he moved to Alabama, or his education and work history outside the legislature. The page we reviewed lists his sponsored bills only as an empty table, so we could not confirm any specific bills. We found no stated positions on data centers, development, property taxes, immigration, guns, abortion, schools or policing. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2019, 2022 or 2026. Ballotpedia identified no endorsements for him in 2026, and we found no documented controversies or foreign ties.

qual.background: Smith has served in the Alabama House of Representatives since November 2019, winning the 2019 special election and re-election in 2022 and 2026. Committee seats have included Ways and Means General Fund (2023-2024).
qual.why: Roughly six years of prior legislative service puts him in the high range for a job that writes law and the state budget. His career outside the legislature could not be found, so the score sits at the low end of that range. Committee seats were not counted.
